script:
"""
Auto Leave Allocation — January 1 Tenure-Based Increment
=========================================================

ONE Scheduled Script needed in ERPNext:

  Script Type : Scheduler Event
  Frequency   : Cron
  Cron        : 0 0 1 1 *
  Entry point : run_january1()

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FIELDS USED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  date_of_joining                 — used to compute years of service
  custom_date_of_regularization   — used to determine which Jan 1 gets the +1

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
POLICIES COVERED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  HR-LPOL-2026-00001  RnF and Leadman         base=8,  cap=13  ← increments
  HR-LPOL-2026-00002  Foreman and Supervisor  base=10, cap=13  ← increments
  HR-LPOL-2026-00003  Manager                base=13, cap=13  ← already at cap, not touched

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BUSINESS RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  Every +1 always happens on January 1.
  Same June 15 cutoff rule applies to all policies.

  EARLY GROUP — regularized on or before June 15
    eligible_from_year = regularization_year + 1
    Example: regularized May 17, 2026 → first +1 on Jan 1, 2027

  LATE GROUP — regularized after June 15
    eligible_from_year = regularization_year + 2
    Example: regularized Jun 16, 2026 → first +1 on Jan 1, 2028

  ALLOCATION FORMULA:
    allocation = min(base + 1 + years_of_increment, cap)
    where years_of_increment = current_year - eligible_from_year

  RnF & Leadman (base=8):
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 0 → 9 days
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 1 → 10 days
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 2 → 11 days
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 3 → 12 days
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 4 → 13 days (capped, stops)

  Foreman & Supervisor (base=10):
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 0 → 11 days
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 1 → 12 days
    Jan 1 of eligible_from_year + 2 → 13 days (capped, stops)

  Manager (base=13): already at cap — script skips entirely.

  Fixed leave types (same every year for all policies):
    Birthday Leave   — 1 day
    Maternity Leave  — 105 days
    Paternity Leave  — 7 days
"""

import frappe
from frappe.utils import today, getdate
from datetime import date


# ── Policy Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each entry: (policy_name, base_allocation, cap)
# Manager is excluded — already at cap, no increment needed.

POLICY_CONFIG = [
    ("HR-LPOL-2026-00001", 8.0,  13.0),   # RnF and Leadman
    ("HR-LPOL-2026-00002", 10.0, 13.0),   # Foreman and Supervisor
]

# ── Other Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CUTOFF_MONTH = 6    # June
CUTOFF_DAY   = 15   # 15th

TENURE_LEAVE_TYPES = ["Vacation Leave", "Sick Leave"]

FIXED_LEAVE_TYPES = {
    "Birthday Leave" : 1.0,
    "Maternity Leave": 105.0,
    "Paternity Leave": 7.0,
}


# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def is_early_group(regularization_date):
    """True if regularized on or before June 15."""
    reg = getdate(regularization_date)
    return (reg.month, reg.day) <= (CUTOFF_MONTH, CUTOFF_DAY)


def get_eligible_from_year(regularization_date):
    """First Jan 1 this employee is eligible for a +1."""
    reg = getdate(regularization_date)
    return reg.year + 1 if is_early_group(regularization_date) else reg.year + 2


def get_allocation_for_year(regularization_date, base, cap, current_year):
    """
    Returns the correct VL/SL allocation for this employee on Jan 1
    of current_year. Returns None if not yet eligible or already at cap.
    """
    eligible_from = get_eligible_from_year(regularization_date)

    if current_year < eligible_from:
        return None  # Not yet eligible

    years_of_increment = current_year - eligible_from
    allocation = base + 1 + years_of_increment

    if allocation > cap:
        return None  # Already at cap

    return min(allocation, cap)


def allocation_exists(employee, leave_type, from_date, to_date):
    """True if a submitted allocation already covers this exact period."""
    return frappe.db.exists("Leave Allocation", {
        "employee"  : employee,
        "leave_type": leave_type,
        "from_date" : from_date,
        "to_date"   : to_date,
        "docstatus" : 1,
    })


def make_allocation(employee, employee_name, leave_type, days, from_date, to_date):
    """Create, insert, and submit a Leave Allocation. Returns doc name."""
    doc = frappe.new_doc("Leave Allocation")
    doc.employee             = employee
    doc.employee_name        = employee_name
    doc.leave_type           = leave_type
    doc.from_date            = from_date
    doc.to_date              = to_date
    doc.new_leaves_allocated = days
    doc.carry_forward        = 0
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    doc.submit()
    return doc.name


def log(msg, level="info"):
    frappe.log_error(
        title=f"[Auto Leave] {level.upper()}",
        message=msg,
    )


def get_policy_employees(policy_name):
    """All active employees currently assigned to the given leave policy."""
    assignments = frappe.get_all(
        "Leave Policy Assignment",
        filters={"leave_policy": policy_name, "docstatus": 1},
        fields=["employee"],
    )
    if not assignments:
        return []

    ids = [a["employee"] for a in assignments]
    return frappe.get_all(
        "Employee",
        filters={"name": ["in", ids], "status": "Active"},
        fields=[
            "name",
            "employee_name",
            "date_of_joining",
            "custom_date_of_regularization",
            "company",
        ],
    )


# ── Main: January 1 runner ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def run_january1():
    """
    Runs every January 1.
    Loops through all configured policies and their employees.
    For each employee:
      1. Reads custom_date_of_regularization
      2. Determines correct VL/SL allocation for this year
      3. Creates and submits Leave Allocation if not already existing
      4. Also creates fixed leave types (Birthday, Maternity, Paternity)
    """
    today_date   = getdate(today())
    current_year = today_date.year
    period_from  = date(current_year, 1, 1)
    period_to    = date(current_year, 12, 31)

    log(f"=== Auto Leave Allocation — January 1, {current_year} ===")

    grand_created = grand_skipped = grand_errors = 0

    for policy_name, base, cap in POLICY_CONFIG:

        employees = get_policy_employees(policy_name)
        log(f"--- Policy: {policy_name} | base={base} days | cap={cap} days | employees: {len(employees)} ---")

        total_created = total_skipped = total_errors = 0

        for emp in employees:
            reg_date = emp.get("custom_date_of_regularization")

            # ── Guard: regularization date must be filled ──
            if not reg_date:
                log(
                    f"SKIP {emp['employee_name']} ({emp['name']}) — "
                    f"custom_date_of_regularization is empty. Please fill it in.",
                    "warning",
                )
                total_skipped += 1
                continue

            group      = "EARLY (≤ Jun 15)" if is_early_group(reg_date) else "LATE (> Jun 15)"
            eligible   = get_eligible_from_year(reg_date)
            allocation = get_allocation_for_year(reg_date, base, cap, current_year)

            # ── Not yet eligible or already at cap ──
            if allocation is None:
                if current_year < eligible:
                    log(
                        f"SKIP {emp['employee_name']} | {policy_name} | {group} | "
                        f"reg: {reg_date} | eligible from Jan 1, {eligible} | "
                        f"not yet eligible in {current_year}"
                    )
                else:
                    log(
                        f"SKIP {emp['employee_name']} | {policy_name} | "
                        f"already at max {cap} days — no further increment"
                    )
                total_skipped += 1
                continue

            # ── Tenure leave types: Vacation Leave & Sick Leave ──
            for lt in TENURE_LEAVE_TYPES:
                try:
                    if allocation_exists(emp["name"], lt, period_from, period_to):
                        log(f"SKIP {emp['employee_name']} | {lt} | already exists for {current_year}")
                        total_skipped += 1
                        continue

                    doc_name = make_allocation(
                        emp["name"], emp["employee_name"],
                        lt, allocation, period_from, period_to,
                    )
                    log(
                        f"CREATED {emp['employee_name']} ({emp['name']}) | "
                        f"{policy_name} | {group} | reg: {reg_date} | "
                        f"{lt} | {allocation} days | {current_year} | {doc_name}"
                    )
                    total_created += 1

                except Exception as e:
                    total_errors += 1
                    log(f"ERROR {emp['employee_name']} | {lt} | {e}", "error")
                    frappe.db.rollback()

            # ── Fixed leave types: Birthday, Maternity, Paternity ──
            for lt, fixed_days in FIXED_LEAVE_TYPES.items():
                try:
                    if allocation_exists(emp["name"], lt, period_from, period_to):
                        total_skipped += 1
                        continue

                    doc_name = make_allocation(
                        emp["name"], emp["employee_name"],
                        lt, fixed_days, period_from, period_to,
                    )
                    log(
                        f"CREATED {emp['employee_name']} | "
                        f"{lt} | {fixed_days} days (fixed) | {doc_name}"
                    )
                    total_created += 1

                except Exception as e:
                    total_errors += 1
                    log(f"ERROR {emp['employee_name']} | {lt} | {e}", "error")
                    frappe.db.rollback()

        log(
            f"--- Policy {policy_name} done | "
            f"Created: {total_created} | Skipped: {total_skipped} | Errors: {total_errors} ---"
        )
        grand_created += total_created
        grand_skipped += total_skipped
        grand_errors  += total_errors

    frappe.db.commit()
    log(
        f"=== All policies done for {current_year} | "
        f"Total Created: {grand_created} | "
        f"Total Skipped: {grand_skipped} | "
        f"Total Errors: {grand_errors} ==="
    )


# ── Entry point ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_january1()

# Trigger: After Submit
# Doctype: Stock Entry

import frappe
from collections import defaultdict

def create_inter_company_journal_entries(doc):
    # Allowed transfer types to apply this script on
    allowed_types = ["Intercompany Warehouse Transfer", "Provincial Warehouse Transfer"]

    # Exit early if not one of the allowed types
    if doc.stock_entry_type not in allowed_types:
        return

    # Step 1: Summarize amounts by item group
    summary = defaultdict(lambda: {"amount": 0.0, "uom": None})

    for item in doc.items:
        if not item.t_warehouse or not item.s_warehouse:
            continue

        item_group = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item.item_code, "item_group")
        if not item_group:
            frappe.throw(f"Item {item.item_code} has no Item Group defined.")

        amount = item.valuation_rate * item.qty
        summary[item_group]["amount"] += amount

    # Step 2: Identify source and target companies from warehouses
    first_item = doc.items[0]
    source_company = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", first_item.s_warehouse, "company")
    target_company = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", first_item.t_warehouse, "company")

    if not source_company or not target_company:
        frappe.throw("Cannot determine company from warehouse.")

    # Skip if same company (not inter-company)
    if source_company == target_company:
        return

    # Step 3: Fetch account mappings for all item groups
    mapping = {}
    for item_group in summary:
        filters = {
            "source_company": source_company,
            "target_company": target_company,
            "item_group": item_group,
        }
        map_doc = frappe.get_all(
            "Inter Company Transfer Account Mapping",
            filters=filters,
            fields=[
                "item_group", "receivable_account", "income_account",
                "payable_account", "expense_account"
            ],
            limit=1
        )

        if not map_doc:
            frappe.throw(
                f"No account mapping found for item group '{item_group}' between {source_company} and {target_company}"
            )

        mapping[item_group] = map_doc[0]

    # Step 4: Build Journal Entry per company
    def make_je(company, entries, against_company):
        je = frappe.new_doc("Journal Entry")
        je.voucher_type = "Journal Entry"
        je.company = company
        je.posting_date = doc.posting_date
        je.remark = f"Auto-generated inter-company JE for Stock Entry {doc.name} to {against_company}"

        for entry in entries:
            je.append("accounts", entry)

        je.insert()
        je.submit()
        frappe.msgprint(f"Journal Entry {je.name} created for {company}")
        return je.name

    # Prepare Journal Entry lines per company
    source_entries = []
    target_entries = []

    for item_group, values in summary.items():
        amount = values["amount"]
        accounts = mapping[item_group]

        # Source Company JE lines
        source_entries.append({
            "account": accounts["receivable_account"],
            "debit_in_account_currency": amount,
            "credit_in_account_currency": 0.0,
            "party_type": "Company",
            "party": target_company,
            "cost_center": None
        })
        source_entries.append({
            "account": accounts["income_account"],
            "debit_in_account_currency": 0.0,
            "credit_in_account_currency": amount,
            "cost_center": None
        })

        # Target Company JE lines
        target_entries.append({
            "account": accounts["expense_account"],
            "debit_in_account_currency": amount,
            "credit_in_account_currency": 0.0,
            "cost_center": None
        })
        target_entries.append({
            "account": accounts["payable_account"],
            "debit_in_account_currency": 0.0,
            "credit_in_account_currency": amount,
            "party_type": "Company",
            "party": source_company,
            "cost_center": None
        })

    # Step 5: Create Journal Entries
    make_je(source_company, source_entries, target_company)
    make_je(target_company, target_entries, source_company)

# Call the main function with the current document
create_inter_company_journal_entries(doc)

name: Batch Leave Approval-After Submit
script:
def send_leave_email(leave, new_status, recipient, reason):
    try:
        company = frappe.db.get_single_value('Global Defaults', 'default_company')
        email_template = frappe.get_doc('Email Template', 'Leave Status Notification')
        context = {
            'employee_name': leave.employee_name,
            'leave_type': leave.leave_type,
            'from_date': str(leave.from_date),
            'to_date': str(leave.to_date),
            'total_leave_days': leave.total_leave_days,
            'status': new_status,
            'leave_approver': leave.leave_approver,
            'description': reason or leave.description or '',
            'company': company,
            'name': leave.name
        }
        frappe.sendmail(
            recipients=[recipient],
            subject=frappe.render_template(email_template.subject, context),
            message=frappe.render_template(email_template.response_, context),
            reference_doctype='Leave Application',
            reference_name=leave.name
        )
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), 'Batch Leave Approval - Email Error: ' + leave.name)

for row in doc.leave_applications:
    try:
        leave = frappe.get_doc('Leave Application', row.leave_application)
        new_status = 'Approved' if row.action == 'Approve' else 'Rejected'

        if leave.docstatus == 2:
            continue

        # Suppress HRMS notify_employee during submit
        leave.follow_via_email = 0

        if leave.docstatus == 0:
            leave.status = new_status
            leave.flags.ignore_permissions = True
            leave.submit()
        else:
            frappe.db.set_value('Leave Application', leave.name, 'status', new_status)
            leave.reload()

        # Send email - include rejection reason if applicable
        emp = frappe.get_doc('Employee', leave.employee)
        recipient = emp.user_id or emp.prefered_email or emp.company_email or emp.personal_email
        if recipient:
            reason = row.get('reason') or ''
            send_leave_email(leave, new_status, recipient, reason)
        else:
            frappe.log_error('No email for: ' + leave.employee, 'Batch Leave Approval - Missing Email')

    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), 'Batch Leave Approval Error - ' + row.leave_application)
        frappe.throw('Error processing ' + row.leave_application + ': ' + str(e))

# Load original asset
source_asset = frappe.get_doc("Asset", doc.asset)

if len(base_name) + len(suffix) > 140:
    base_name = base_name[:140 - len(suffix)]

new_asset.company = doc.target_comp

new_asset.department = doc.department

new_asset.custom_serial_no = source_asset.custom_serial_no
new_asset.custom_notes = doc.notes  # from inter-company transfer


# Custodian or Section logic

import frappe
from pyjasper.client import JasperPy
import os
import json

def generate_purchase_receipt_report(doc_name=None):
    """
    Generate PDF from Test.jrxml for Purchase Receipt
    """

    # Paths
    jasper_folder = "/home/frappe/jasper_reports"
    template_file = os.path.join(jasper_folder, "Test.jrxml")
    compiled_file = os.path.join(jasper_folder, "Test.jasper")
    output_file = os.path.join(jasper_folder, f"{doc_name}.pdf")
    jar_file = os.path.join(jasper_folder, "jasperreports-7.0.3.jar")

    # Compile .jrxml to .jasper (only once)
    jasper = JasperPy()
    jasper.compile(
        input_file=template_file,
        output_file=compiled_file,
        class_path=jar_file
    )

    # Fetch data from ERPNext
    filters = {}
    if doc_name:
        filters["name"] = doc_name

    data = frappe.get_all(
        "Purchase Receipt",
        filters=filters,
        fields=["name", "supplier", "posting_date", "grand_total"]
    )

    # Save JSON file for Jasper
    json_file = os.path.join(jasper_folder, "data.json")
    with open(json_file, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"data": data}, f)

    # Fill report with JSON data
    jasper.process(
        input_file=compiled_file,
        output_file=output_file,
        format_list=["pdf"],
        parameters={},
        db_connection={"driver":"json","data_file":json_file}  # Use JSON as data source
    )

    # Attach PDF to ERPNext document
    if data:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "File",
            "file_name": f"{doc_name}.pdf",
            "attached_to_doctype": "Purchase Receipt",
            "attached_to_name": doc_name,
            "content": open(output_file, "rb").read(),
            "is_private": 0
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    frappe.msgprint(f"PDF report generated for {doc_name}!")

# Example usage: generate report for a specific document
# generate_purchase_receipt_report("MAT-PRE-2025-00001")

def recalculate_staffing_plan(staffing_plan):
    sp = frappe.get_doc("Staffing Plan", staffing_plan)

    possible_fields = ["staffing_details", "staffing_plan_details"]
    child_field = next((f for f in possible_fields if sp.get(f) is not None), None)

    if not child_field:
        frappe.msgprint("⚠️ Could not find staffing details field.")
        return

    updated_rows = []
    debug_log = []

    for row in sp.get(child_field):
        designation = row.designation

        # count employees with matching designation link
        emp_count = frappe.db.count("Employee", {"designation": designation, "status": "Active"})

        # if still 0, try fuzzy match by designation name (Label instead of Link)
        if emp_count == 0:
            emp_count = frappe.db.count(
                "Employee",
                {"designation": ["like", f"%{designation}%"], "status": "Active"}
            )

        total = getattr(row, "total", 0) or 0

        updated_rows.append({
            "designation": row.designation,
            "total": total,
            "current_count": emp_count,
            "vacancies": max(total - emp_count, 0),
            "name": getattr(row, "name", None),
        })

        debug_log.append(f"{designation}: {emp_count} active employees")

    sp.set(child_field, updated_rows)
    sp.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()

    frappe.msgprint("✅ Recalculated successfully.\n\n" + "\n".join(debug_log))

# Build SQL query based on reference_type
if reference_type == "Sales Order":
    query = """
        SELECT
            soi.item_code,
            soi.item_name,
            soi.qty,
            soi.stock_uom,
            soi.conversion_factor
        FROM `tabSales Order` so
        JOIN `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name
        WHERE so.name = %s AND so.company = %s AND so.docstatus = 1
    """

elif reference_type == "Material Request":
    query = """
        SELECT
            mri.item_code,
            mri.item_name,
            mri.qty,
            mri.stock_uom,
            mri.conversion_factor
        FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
        JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mri ON mri.parent = mr.name
        WHERE mr.name = %s AND mr.company = %s AND mr.docstatus = 1
    """

else:
    frappe.throw("Unsupported reference type: " + reference_type)

# Optional: Log query and params for debugging

# Get all Vehicle Service rows linked to this Vehicle Log
services = frappe.get_all(
    "Vehicle Service",
    filters={"parent": doc.name},
    fields=["service_item", "custom_service_date"],
    order_by="custom_service_date desc"
)



# Get vehicle document using license_plate
vehicle_name = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Vehicle",
    {"license_plate": doc.license_plate},
    "name"
)



for service in services:

    # ENGINE CHANGE OIL
    if service.service_item and "ENGINE CHANGE OIL" in service.service_item.upper():
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Vehicle",
            vehicle_name,
            "custom_last_change_engine_oil_date",
            service.custom_service_date
        )
        break  # only latest needed


# REGISTRATION
for service in services:

    if service.service_item and "REGISTRATION" in service.service_item.upper():

        month = frappe.utils.formatdate(service.custom_service_date, "MMMM")
        year = frappe.utils.formatdate(service.custom_service_date, "yyyy")

        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Vehicle",
            vehicle_name,
            {
                "custom_month": month,
                "custom_year": year
            }
        )
        break  # only latest needed

import frappe

@frappe.whitelist()
def get_asset_items(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters):
    return frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT name, item_name
        FROM `tabItem`
        WHERE
            (
                is_fixed_asset = 1
                OR (is_stock_item = 1 AND custom_is_asset_item = 1)
            )
            AND (name LIKE %(txt)s OR item_name LIKE %(txt)s)
        ORDER BY name
        LIMIT %(start)s, %(page_len)s
    """, {
        "txt": f"%{txt}%",
        "start": start,
        "page_len": page_len
    })

customer = frappe.form_dict.get("customer")
item_code = frappe.form_dict.get("item_code")
company = frappe.form_dict.get("company")

result = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT 
        soi.rate,
        MAX(so.transaction_date) as date,
        GROUP_CONCAT(so.name ORDER BY so.transaction_date DESC SEPARATOR ', ') as sales_orders
    FROM `tabSales Order Item` soi
    JOIN `tabSales Order` so ON soi.parent = so.name
    WHERE so.customer = %s 
        AND soi.item_code = %s
        AND so.docstatus = 1
        and so.company = %s
    GROUP BY soi.rate
    ORDER BY date DESC
""", (customer, item_code,company), as_dict=True)

frappe.response['data'] = result

items = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT
        soi.item_code,
        soi.item_name,
        MAX(so.transaction_date) as last_order_date,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TRIM(soi.rate) + 0  ORDER BY soi.rate DESC) as rates,
        COUNT(*) as times_ordered
    FROM `tabSales Order` so
    JOIN `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name
    WHERE so.customer = %s AND so.docstatus = 1 and so.company = %s
    GROUP BY soi.item_code
    ORDER BY last_order_date DESC
""", (customer,company), as_dict=True)

frappe.response["data"] = items
